blocks.text: subplots can create several plotting areas. Give each area clear labels so readers can compare them correctly.

blocks.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2)
axes[0].bar(["A", "B"], [2, 3])
axes[1].plot([1, 2], [3, 4])
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
blocks.title: Place two plots in one figure

blocks.text: The figure has one row and two plotting areas. The first is a bar chart; the second is a line chart.
